label: drops late in episode at D1 after rewarded S2, and at D2 on S2
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * np.exp((ep_trial-99)/5.) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * np.exp((ep_trial-99)/5.) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.exp((ep_trial-99)/5.) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * np.exp((ep_trial-99)/5.) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 2)
explanation: Candidate n of unit 46 sits near 1 and falls mainly in the last ~10 trials of the episode (timing alone gives R^2 0.70). Beyond timing, the drop depends on the previous trial and grows sharply toward the episode end (modelled as exp((ep_trial-99)/5)). At D1 after a rewarded S2 trial, the late-episode drop is much larger (weight -0.24, D1 values down to ~0.45 at t96-99 vs a timing mean of ~0.80). Reaching S2 at D1 (-0.07) and at D2 (-0.07) lowers it further late in the episode. Early in the episode there is a small offset at D1: reaching S2 lowers it (~-0.015) and reward raises it (~+0.007). GO is almost unaffected. Every term is observed; no future or hidden variables are used. The 7 terms give dev R^2 beyond timing 0.39 and test 0.32, above the table-based all ceiling of 0.23 because the effect interacts with episode time. Remaining errors: under-predicted at D1 after unrewarded S1 trials, and very long late-episode runs of rewarded a2/S2 still fall more than predicted, which points to a cumulative reward/S2 history effect.
